q.zh: 公开问答助手会不会把内部底价或客户名称泄露出去？
q.en: Could the public assistant expose internal pricing or confidential client names?

a.zh: 不会。对外门户与内部销售工作台使用严格分离的索引范围：公开索引在入库前已剔除底价与脱敏客户身份，内部报价参考仅对通过身份认证的员工可见。
a.en: No. Public and internal portals query physically separated index scopes. Sensitive pricing and client identifiers are excluded from the public index and require authenticated staff clearance.

q.zh: 产品参数更新或新增交付案例后，怎么同步到系统？
q.en: How do we keep specifications and new project records up to date?

a.zh: 支持后台上传新版规格表或定时同步业务数据库。旧版参数归档停用后不会再被检索进新回答中。
a.en: You can upload revised spec sheets or sync directly from your database on a schedule. Superseded versions are archived immediately so outdated tolerances stop appearing.

q.zh: 多久能看到第一版效果？
q.en: How quickly can we test a first working version?

a.zh: 可以从一条核心产品线开始做低启动试点，通常 2–6 周即可上线供销售与技术团队实测验收。
a.en: Most teams start with one flagship product line in a focused pilot, reaching a working version for field testing in 2–6 weeks.

q.zh: 系统会不会自己编造不存在的项目业绩或技术参数？
q.en: Will the system invent past project credentials or technical numbers?

a.zh: 不会。数值参数与项目履历强制绑定企业已入库的真实记录；当资料库缺少某项必填数据时，系统会将其列为“缺失信息清单”提醒业务人员填写，绝不自行编造数字。
a.en: No. Credentials and figures must resolve to indexed source records. Whenever a required parameter is missing, the workflow flags an explicit open question for the author rather than fabricating a number.

q.zh: 我们有自己严格的 Word 排版与章节模板，可以适配吗？
q.en: Can it follow our existing Word templates and section rubrics?

a.zh: 可以。立项诊断阶段我们会梳理你现有的标准模板、评审打分点与审核清单，将生成结构与导出格式对齐到团队习惯的文档样式。
a.en: Yes. During assessment we map your section templates, scoring rubrics and approval checklists so generated drafts export cleanly into your team’s standard format.

q.en: Which document type should we automate first?

a.zh: 建议优先选择撰写频率高、历史样本较齐、审核标准清晰的单一文档类型启动 2–6 周试点，跑通并确认省时效果后再横向扩展。
a.en: Start with one high‑frequency document type that has solid historical samples and clear review rules — typically proven in a 2–6 week pilot before adding other formats.

q.zh: 支持接入我们正在用的飞书、企业微信、Confluence 或 SharePoint 吗？
q.en: Can it connect to Confluence, SharePoint, Lark or WeCom?

a.zh: 支持。我们通过标准连接器或只读 API 同步现有知识空间与文档库，员工仍可在熟悉的办公软件窗口内直接提问。
a.en: Yes. We sync existing workspaces and document repositories via read‑only connectors and expose the assistant inside the collaboration tools your employees already use.

q.zh: 如果文档里根本没有写这件事，AI 会不会乱编答案？
q.en: What happens when the knowledge base doesn’t contain the answer?

a.zh: 不会强行作答。当检索置信度不足或条款互相冲突时，系统会明确告知缺少哪部分现行依据，并一键生成带上下文的支持工单转交对应负责人。
a.en: Instead of guessing, the workflow states what policy coverage is missing and offers a one‑click escalation ticket pre‑filled for the responsible team.

q.zh: 私有化部署在企业内网环境可以吗？
q.en: Can the entire knowledge assistant run inside our private environment?

a.zh: 可以。支持完整的 Docker 私有化交付并适配本地推理算力，企业内部制度文档与提问日志全程留在自有环境中。
a.en: Yes. Full Docker private deployment is supported, keeping internal documents, embeddings and query logs entirely inside your environment.

q.zh: AI 生成的查询有没有可能修改或删掉我们的业务数据？
q.en: Could a generated query modify or delete production records?

a.zh: 不可能。一方面数据库连接本身使用数据库级只读账号；另一方面应用层五重策略门禁会在执行前解析语法树，非 SELECT 语句、未加 LIMIT 的大表扫描与敏感列访问都会被直接拦截。
a.en: No. Connections use database‑enforced read‑only credentials, and our AST policy gate blocks any non‑SELECT statement, unbounded table scan or unmasked PII column before execution.

q.zh: 业务人员怎么知道查询出来的数字口径对不对？
q.en: How can users verify that a returned number used the right definition?

a.zh: 每次返回结果时，界面都会同步列出本次使用的业务指标定义、时间范围、所查数据表及生成的完整 SQL，业务与数据人员随时可以核对。
a.en: Every result card displays the applied metric definition, date filter, source tables and exact SQL statement so analysts or managers can verify the logic at a glance.

q.zh: 我们的表字段命名不规范，需要先重构数仓才能用吗？
q.en: Do we have to rebuild our data warehouse before starting?

a.zh: 不需要。试点阶段我们先围绕最常用的 5–10 张核心业务表建立一层轻量语义字典，映射字段含义与计算口径，2–6 周即可上线验证。
a.en: No. We start by mapping a lightweight semantic dictionary over the 5–10 tables behind your most frequent questions, delivering a working pilot in 2–6 weeks without warehouse refactoring.
